title: COLDCARD seed-generation entropy defect
summary: Affected firmware could generate seeds with substantially less entropy than intended. Updating firmware does not repair an already-generated seed.
mitigation: Stop issuing new receive addresses from the affected wallet.
Create a new seed using fixed firmware or an independent trusted signer.
Verify the new fingerprint and receive address on a separate device.
Migrate with a small test transaction before moving the remaining funds.
Treat the old seed as permanently compromised.

title: Trezor shipping-provider customer-data breach
summary: A third-party logistics breach exposed customer order data. Devices and private keys were not reported compromised, but phishing and targeted-attack risk increased.
mitigation: Never enter a wallet backup on a website.
Verify urgent communications using an independently opened official channel.
Minimize and expire order data held by third parties.
Do not store customer identity and wallet ownership in the same trust domain.
